issue: scripts/local_validation.py published a vacuous audit receipt when repro/programs.json was an empty or malformed selector: main() validated no program, wrote programs: {} to audit/local-validation.json and exited 0.
cause: The archived selector was returned verbatim after only a dict check. An empty object makes main()'s loop run zero times; a blank or non-string address only surfaced later, inside Pubkey.from_string, with no hint that the selector was at fault.

reproduction.base: repro/programs.json = {} -> program_addresses() returns {}; main() writes {'programs': {}} and exits 0

change: Refuse an empty selector and any non-string or blank program name or address before returning it, so a run cannot publish a receipt that validated nothing.

tests.before: 5 failing subtests against the base script (empty selector and the four malformed-address selectors); the valid-selector and capture-fallback controls pass on both

not_claimed: No LiteSVM smoke run is executed here (main() needs solders; the maintained audit/local-validation.json receipt was not regenerated). The valid-selector path is unchanged, so an existing receipt remains reproducible.
pin_note: No live binding pins scripts/local_validation.py. research/amm-staging-source-containment-20261030/REQUIRED-INPUTS.json records a historical donor revision, not a drift guard on the working tree, so nothing is rebound.
